title: Action Verbs
text:
I like to be active. Every day I run, jump, and swim. I walk to school with my friend. In the park, we climb the trees and kick the ball. Action verbs show what we do.

My sister likes to read. She opens a book and looks at the pictures. At night, she writes in her diary. Sometimes she draws, too. Action verbs are important because they tell us what people do.

questions.text: What does the writer do every day?
What does the sister do at night?
What kind of person is the writer?
options: A shy person who never leaves home
A person who does not like friends

questions.text: What can we guess about the sister?
options: She likes quiet activities such as reading and writing

vocabulary.definition: doing many things and moving a lot
to go up something using your hands and feet
a book where you write about your day

paragraph_translations: Aktif olmayı severim. Her gün koşarım, zıplarım ve yüzerim. Arkadaşımla okula yürürüm. Parkta ağaçlara tırmanır ve topu tekmeleriz. Eylem fiilleri ne yaptığımızı gösterir.
Kız kardeşim kitap okumayı sever. Bir kitap açar ve resimlere bakar. Geceleri günlüğüne yazar. Bazen de resim çizer. Eylem fiilleri önemlidir, çünkü insanların ne yaptığını bize söyler.
